- Defines the provider abstraction through `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct, which represents the common user information model returned by any identity provider

- OAuth2 is the concrete protocol implementation that ships with the repository
- Contains the `IdentityProvider` struct that implements OAuth2 identity provider integration

**Answer:** `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp`; `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2`
